description: Insider trades at the company behind one Robinhood Stock Token on Robinhood Chain, from SEC Form 4 filings of the last 90 days (the newest 40 at most; the window covered is stated): who (owner and relationship), the date, the transaction code in words, shares (signed by acquired or disposed), price (or "see footnote"), shares owned after, the Rule 10b5-1 flag and the filing link; a 4/A replaces its original; purchase and sale totals (codes P and S); plus the latest Schedule 13D/G filings naming the company. limit: rows to list (1 to 100, default 15). Foreign filers file no Form 4. Facts, not advice.

id.description: A stock ticker as Robinhood lists it (AAPL, NVDA, BRK.B) or the Stock Token's contract on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex)

limit.description: How many trade rows to list, 1 to 100 (default 15)

name: insider_trades
title: Insider trades
